Field.name: TomogramOrSizeXYZ
Field.usage: Input file to be cut up, or the dimensions in X, Y and Z

Field.name: MegaVoxels
Field.usage: Maximum number of megavoxels to allow in each piece (default 80)

Field.name: XPadding
Field.usage: Number of pixels to pad on each side in X (default 8)

Field.name: YPadding
Field.usage: Number of pixels to pad on each side in Y (default 4)

Field.name: ZPadding
Field.usage: Number of pixels to pad on each side in Z (default 8)

Field.name: XMaximumPieces
Field.usage: Maximum number of pieces in X (default is 0)
Field.manpage: Maximum number of pieces in X. Enter -1 for essentially no constraints (a maximum of X image size divided by 2). The default is 0 for X and Y, which will make the total number of pieces in X and Y be no more than 100. If the maximum for Y is set to 1, a value of 0 for X will make the number of pieces in X be no more than 100. These constraints will allow Assemblevol to keep all files in one layer in Z open at once.

Field.name: YMaximumPieces
Field.usage: Maximum number of pieces in Y (default is 0; entries of 0 for X and Y give a maximum total in X and Y of 100)
Field.manpage: Maximum number of pieces in Y. Enter -1 for essentially no constraints (a maximum of Y image size divided by 2). The default is 0; see entry for XMaximumPieces. If the maximum for X is set to 1, a value of 0 for Y will make the number of pieces in Y be no more than 100.

Field.name: ZMaximumPieces
Field.usage: Maximum number of pieces in Z; the default is -1 for NZ/2
Field.manpage: Maximum number of pieces in Z. The default is -1 for essentially no constraints (a maximum of Z image size divided by 2).

Field.name: MinimumOverlap
Field.usage: Minimum number of pixels to overlap between pieces (default 4)

Field.name: ChunksForHDF
Field.usage: Set up for direct output to a chunked HDF file
Field.manpage: Set up for direct output to a chunked HDF file. The program will generate equally spaced chunks on each axis with a size that minimizes the wasted space in the last chunk.

Field.name: NoFFTSizes
Field.usage: Do not adjust the padding to give sizes suitable for an FFT
Field.manpage: Do not adjust the padding to give sizes suitable for an FFT. If this option is entered, be sure that it is also sent to Taperoutvol(1).

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
